title: OpenAI, Google, Microsoft and Anthropic adopt shared robots.txt policy token
content:
X author: @Xpress_24_7

OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic will adopt a shared policy token in robots.txt proposed at the IETF by Anthropic standards lead Kevin Kelley, enabling publishers to opt out of AI training scraping once for all participating crawlers.

Linked sources:
- https://www.theverge.com/tech/1023763/openai-google-microsoft-ai-scraping-standard-opt-out

novelty.reason: The announcement that OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, and Anthropic are supporting a unified robots.txt standard for AI training opt-outs was already recorded.
